note: Doctor packs: what each doctor's programme adds on top of the shared data (step 2 of the plugin). Constraint layers merge strictest first: the doctor pack, then the patient's safety (allergies, conditions, medicines), then preferences (diet, avoid list). A pack can only add restrictions (never_foods, lower limits); it can never relax a patient's safety layer. approved_recipes are recipe IDs from the recipe collection that the doctor recommends: they are searched first and shown with the doctor's badge. DP-0.1.0 (26 Oct 2026): development pack only. The doctor has not reviewed it, so never_foods and limits are empty and the eight first recipes stand in for the doctor's list. Production refuses this file until the doctor signs it (approved_by, approved_on). DP-0.2.0 (26 Oct 2026): the eight stand-in recipes are gone (no doctor has picked recipes yet); recipe_books names the programme's Healthful Diet book, whose dishes are searched right after the doctor's own list.
